events.name: Santa's Grotto at Battersea Arts Centre
events.what: Meet Santa in his grotto, take photos and share wish lists in the arts centre.

events.name: Free Santa's Grotto, Bermondsey Square Hotel
events.saleNote: Free Eventbrite tickets in past years. 2026 not confirmed
events.what: A free grotto experience run by the hotel. Free tickets go fast when released.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at Capel Manor Gardens
events.price: £6 per child for the grotto, garden entry extra
events.saleNote: One weekend only, booking status unconfirmed
events.what: Grotto visit as part of Christmas at Capel Manor Gardens.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at Charlton House
events.saleNote: One weekend only, booking status unconfirmed
events.what: Santa's grotto in the Jacobean Charlton House as part of its Christmas weekend.

events.name: Chelsea lights switch-on
events.venue: Duke of York Square & Sloane Street
events.what: Street performers, carol singing and snow flurries for the Chelsea lights switch-on.

events.name: Father Christmas Storytelling
events.what: Stories with Father Christmas in London's oldest botanic garden.

events.name: Chelsea Winter Illuminations
events.price: Check booking page (Winter Village is free)
events.saleNote: Venue says tickets are selling fast. No dates showing sold out yet
events.toddler: No scooters on the trail. The Winter Village is free if you just want the atmosphere.
events.what: Central London's only festive light trail through Ranelagh Gardens, with a free Winter Village: food hall, fairground rides, fire pits and the Chelsea Pensioners Choir.

events.name: Chiswick House Christmas & Grotto
events.runs: Last year 21 Nov – 4 Jan, grotto from 29 Nov
events.what: Georgian Christmas experience in the house, plus Father Christmas in an 18th-century style grotto with a story and gift.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at Deen City Farm
events.price: £8.50 per child incl. gift and one adult, extra adults £3
events.saleNote: 2026 dates out, booking link not confirmed yet
events.venue: Deen City Farm, Merton Abbey SW19
events.what: Farm grotto visit with a gift for every child.

events.name: Victorian Santa's Grotto
events.toddler: Short 15-minute sessions and quiet early slots suit little ones. Museum entry is free for the rest of you.
events.venue: London Museum Docklands, West India Quay
events.what: Walk through the museum's Victorian Sailortown street to meet Santa. Four children per 15-minute session, and the first two sessions each day are quiet sessions.

events.name: Father Christmas at Ealing Broadway
events.what: Shopping-centre grotto visit.

events.name: Storytelling with Father Christmas
events.saleNote: Booked via Fortnum's Eventbrite. Released 5 Sept and selling fast; places limited, cancellations go back on sale
events.toddler: For ages 3 to 11, so one for a couple of years' time.
events.what: A festive story told by Father Christmas in Fortnum's boardroom, with a goodie bag and the chance to make last-minute present requests. Up to two adults per child, adults don't need tickets.

events.name: Santa's Winter Garden
events.what: A new Santa experience in the Fulham Palace gardens.

events.name: Greenwich Market lights & lantern parade
events.what: Lights switch-on with a children's lantern parade and live entertainment.

events.name: Hamleys Santa's Grotto
events.toddler: Aimed at ages 2–10, so better next year.
events.what: The famous toy-shop grotto: elves guide you through before meeting Santa, with a keepsake to take home.

events.name: Hampstead Village lights switch-on
events.toddler: Sunday timing and real reindeer make this a good one for little ones.
events.what: Lights switch-on with funfair rides, Santa and reindeer, and carols.

events.name: Santa's Secret Village
events.what: An immersive festive village walk ending in a private meet-and-greet with Santa in his grotto.

events.name: Father Christmas at Kenwood
events.what: English Heritage's Father Christmas visit at Kenwood House.

events.name: Christmas at Kew
events.saleNote: Not fully sold out, but December is going fast and standard tickets show sold out on some dates. Best availability is November. Quiet Access still open 16 and 26 Dec
events.toddler: Under-4s go free. Pick an early slot (4.20pm) so it's not past bedtime.
events.what: London's big festive light trail through the gardens after dark, with the Temperate House light show, a Fire Garden and food stalls. Timed entry 4.20–7.40pm.

events.name: Santa at Lower Morden Garden Centre
events.what: Garden centre Santa visit.

events.name: Santa at London Transport Museum
events.toddler: Kids free and plenty of vehicles to climb on.
events.what: Meet Santa in a twinkly winter garden inside the museum, alongside the old buses and tube trains.

events.name: Merry Marylebone lights switch-on
events.what: Marylebone Village switches on its lights with a Santa's grotto, Ferris wheel and food and gift stalls.

events.name: Visit Father Christmas, Morden Hall Park
events.what: National Trust Father Christmas visit with a wrapped gift for each child.

events.name: Santa at Mudchute
events.saleNote: Not announced yet. Last year was one weekend, so it'll go fast
events.toddler: Animals up close plus Santa, a good combo for little ones.
events.venue: Mudchute Park & Farm, Isle of Dogs
events.what: Meet Santa and some of the farm animals up close in the Mudchute courtyard. Each child gets a gift. Groups of up to 3 kids and 2 adults.

events.name: Storytelling with Father Christmas
events.what: Father Christmas storytelling sessions at the museum.

events.name: Father Christmas at the Old Royal Naval College
events.what: Meet Father Christmas in Greenwich's historic college buildings.

events.name: Baby & Toddler Breakfast with Santa
events.what: Breakfast with Santa sessions made for babies and toddlers.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at the Queen's House
events.price: £30 per person, under-1s free, plus £3 booking fee
events.saleNote: Some dates already sold out or nearly full
events.toddler: Every person over 1 needs a ticket, so it's pricier for a family.
events.what: Santa's grotto inside the historic Queen's House. Relaxed sessions for SEND visitors too.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at Spitalfields City Farm
events.saleNote: No 2026 news yet. Past years ran on a small suggested donation
events.what: Walk through the farm's grotto garden with Santa's elves to find Santa. The donkey stands in for Rudolph, plus crafts and a café.

events.name: Christmas Wonderland at Springtime Nurseries
events.what: Garden centre Christmas Wonderland with a Santa visit.

events.name: St Katharine Docks lights switch-on
events.venue: St Katharine Docks, by Tower Bridge
events.what: School choirs, a visit from St Nick and a Victorian Christmas village around the marina.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at St Paul's Church
events.what: A grotto in the actors' church off the Covent Garden piazza.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at Stanley Arts
events.toddler: Cheap, relaxed and flexible on timing, which helps with nap schedules.
events.what: A small snowy grotto in a local arts centre. Book a time window, chat to Santa and every child gets a present.

events.name: Surrey Docks Farm Christmas Fair
events.saleNote: Usually early December, 2026 date not out
events.what: Community Christmas fair at the riverside farm with stalls and farm animals.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at Vauxhall City Farm
events.toddler: Small, cheap and has animals to look at while you wait.
events.what: Meet an elf, then Santa in a decorated grotto. Every child gets a gift, and you can wander round the farm animals after.

events.name: Walworth Road lights switch-on
events.what: Local lights designed by children, switched on by the Mayor of Southwark.

events.name: Regent Street & Carnaby lights switch-on
events.runs: From early Nov to early Jan
events.saleNote: Regent St switch-on 5–9pm. Carnaby on Wed 4 Nov
events.toddler: Free and quick. Go early evening on a weekday to dodge crowds.
events.what: The West End street lights go on: Carnaby Street on Wed 4 Nov, Regent Street's Spirit of Christmas angels on Thu 5 Nov.

events.name: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland
events.price: Grotto free. Entry free off-peak, £5.50 standard, £8.25 peak
events.saleNote: Santa Land grotto is free, first come first served. You still book a timed entry (off-peak entry is free)
events.toddler: Weekday off-peak mornings are quietest. Santa Land is the toddler bit.
events.what: London's giant winter funfair with lights, ice rink, Christmas market and Santa Land with its own grotto. Everyone needs a timed entry ticket, even off-peak.

events.name: Santa's Grotto at The Mall Wood Green
events.price: £7.50 per child, incl. £1 to North London Hospice
events.toddler: Cheap and easy to fit around naps.
events.what: Shopping-centre grotto, one of the earliest to open.

events.name: Christmas Candy Grotto, Woolwich Works
events.price: £12 per child + £1.50 booking fee, adults free, under-12-months free
events.toddler: At 18 months she'll need her own ticket. Family events in the programme are aimed at ages 0–8.
events.what: Santa, cheeky elves, festive activities and treats. Also a family Santa silent disco and gospel choir concert in the same programme.

events.name: London Christmas Village
events.what: Pop-up Christmas village with a Santa experience.

events.name: Santa at London Zoo
events.saleNote: 2026 dates listed, booking status unconfirmed. Sold quickly in past years
events.what: A festive grotto inside the zoo, combined with a zoo day out.
